classification.difficultyReason: Translate three union components into separate number-line regions with the correct open endpoints, closed endpoints, and ray.

content.prompt: Sketch the following on the number line. $[-1,1]\cup[2,3)\cup(4,\infty)$

answer.worked: Join filled $-1$ to filled $1$. Join filled $2$ to open $3$. Draw a rightward ray from open $4$. Leave the gaps between these three intervals.

spec.description: Two finite segments and one rightward ray above an axis with integer ticks -2 through 5.
